mechanism_narrative: Rising housing starts (HOUST) indicate strengthening consumer confidence and construction activity, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns as equity markets anticipate sustained economic expansion driven by housing demand.
failure_condition: HOUST rises above 1050 but 20-day forward returns are negative in >60% of instances over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Declining industrial production (INDPRO) signals manufacturing contraction and weakening supply capacity, triggering negative S&P 500 returns as equity valuations adjust to lower output expectations.
failure_condition: INDPRO < 99.0 occurs but 20-day forward returns are positive in >60% of cases over a 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: FEDFUNDS at or below 0.4% indicates ultra-accommodative monetary policy, compressing discount rates and boosting equity valuations through sustained low-cost capital access for corporate investment.
failure_condition: FEDFUNDS <= 0.4% but 20-day forward returns are negative in >60% of periods over a 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous HOUST growth and INDPRO decline signal demand-supply misalignment where housing strength fails to offset manufacturing weakness, generating negative S&P 500 returns as market confidence erodes.
failure_condition: HOUST > 1050 AND INDPRO < 99.0 occur but 20-day returns are positive in >60% of cases over a 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In monetary easing cycles (FEDFUNDS ≤ 0.5%), CPIAUCSL above 240.0 indicates inflation nearing policy comfort levels, triggering negative S&P 500 returns as markets anticipate rate hikes to curb price pressures.
failure_condition: CPIAUCSL > 240.0 in FEDFUNDS ≤ 0.5% regime but 20-day returns are positive in >60% of instances over a 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: Payroll growth (PAYEMS) exceeding 145,000 signals robust labor market conditions that sustain consumer spending and corporate earnings, generating positive S&P 500 returns through sustained demand momentum.
failure_condition: PAYEMS > 145,000 but 5-day forward returns are negative in >60% of cases over a 1-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: GDPC1 growth above 19,000 billion dollars reflects strong GDP momentum, driving positive S&P 500 returns as equity markets price in sustained corporate profitability from robust economic output.
failure_condition: GDPC1 > 19000 but 60-day forward returns are negative in >60% of periods over a 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: CPIAUCSL between 240.0 and 245.0 in low-FEDFUNDS environments (≤0.5%) indicates stable inflation that avoids policy tightening, generating positive S&P 500 returns through sustained market confidence.
failure_condition: CPIAUCSL between 240.0-245.0 with FEDFUNDS ≤ 0.5% but 20-day returns are negative in >60% of cases over a 2-year window.
